rules.heading: SIGNIFICANCE OF THE KAALHORA

planetary.freeform: Deeds prescribed for a particular day or nakshatra may be performed during the Kaal Hora of the lord of that day or the 15th part (Muhurta/Tithyamsha) of that nakshatra, subject to avoiding Vaar Shoola, Nakshatra Shoola, and Parighdanda.

rules.notes: Rules concerning the substitution of favorable Kaal Horas or nakshatra parts when performing deeds on otherwise unsuitable days.

rules.heading: THE TITHIS MANU ETC AND YUGA ETC.

planetary.freeform: Specific tithis in bright halves of specified months: 3rd and 15th of Chaitra, 15th and 12th of Kartika, 10th and 15th of Ashadha, 15th of Jyeshtha, 15th of Phalguna, 9th of Ashwin, 7th of Magha, and 11th of the month...

rules.notes: Lists specific auspicious tithis during the bright halves of various lunar months for special ceremonies and yuga/manu celebrations.
